Run fast clustering on a SingleCells object (GPU)

fast_cluster_gpu_sc.Rd

GPU counterpart of bixverse::fast_cluster_sc(). Coarsens the cells with k-means on the chosen embedding, builds a graph over the centroids (a kNN graph or the cell-mediated graph), runs Louvain or Leiden on it and propagates the communities back to the cells. With n_seeds > 1 every resolution is run once per seed and stability statistics are returned.

Only the k-means coarsening (and the cell-mediated top-m search) run on the GPU. The centroid graph and the community detection stay on the CPU, so the speedup tracks how much of the run k-means owns. That share grows with the cell count and with n_centroids. There is no km_type argument: the GPU k-means is full-batch Lloyd's and has no mini-batch path.

Usage

fast_cluster_gpu_sc(
  object,
  embd_to_use = "pca",
  no_embd_to_use = NULL,
  resolutions = c(2, 1, 0.5),
  fc_params = params_sc_fast_cluster_gpu(),
  n_seeds = 1L,
  return_kmeans = FALSE,
  seed = 42L,
  backend = c("wgpu", "mlx"),
  n_centroids = lifecycle::deprecated(),
  snn = lifecycle::deprecated(),
  grid_search = lifecycle::deprecated(),
  no_seeds = lifecycle::deprecated(),
  .verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

object

SingleCells or SingleCellsSubset class from bixverse.

embd_to_use

String. Embedding name. Defaults to "pca".

no_embd_to_use

Optional integer. Number of dimensions to keep.

resolutions

Numeric vector. Resolutions of the community detection.

fc_params

List. Output of params_sc_fast_cluster_gpu().

n_seeds

Integer. Number of seeds per resolution. 1L runs a single pass without stability statistics.

return_kmeans

Boolean. Return the k-means assignments and centroids.

seed

Integer. Seed for reproducibility.

backend

String. One of c("wgpu", "mlx"). "mlx" runs the k-means on Apple Silicon via MLX and needs a build with the MLX backend, see mlx_available().

n_centroids

Use params_sc_fast_cluster_gpu(n_centroids = ).

snn

Use params_sc_fast_cluster_gpu(centroid_graph = list(knn_sym = )).

grid_search

Use n_seeds.

no_seeds

Use n_seeds.

.verbose

Boolean or integer. Controls verbosity and returns run times. FALSE -> quiet, TRUE or 1L -> normal verbosity, 2L -> detailed verbosity.

Value

SingleCellFastClusters S3 object with:

memberships

data.table with cell_idx and one column per resolution (res_<value>).

stats

data.table of the stability statistics, or NULL for n_seeds = 1L.

k_means_cluster

Integer vector of k-means assignments, or NULL.

centroids

Numeric matrix of centroids, or NULL.

resolutions

Resolutions used.

with cell_indices stored as an attribute (0-indexed).
